title: Space Weather Training Course 2027
about: ESA Academy's Space Weather Training Course 2027 runs 8 to 12 March 2027 at ESEC-Galaxia, Belgium. Applications go through ESA Learn with a motivation letter, Europass CV and recommendation letter, and close 27 December 2026 at 23:55 CET.
requirements: Recommendation letter from a university professor or academic supervisor
card_alt: Card for the Space Weather Training Course 2027 by the European Space Agency (ESA), ESA Academy, held in Belgium, with an application deadline of 27 Dec 2026. The photo shows the Atomium in Brussels.
